name: pigment
description: What your prompts, tasks and sessions cost, beside the chat — and for a manager, the sprint by task and who is working now. A calm nudge to start fresh when a conversation gets long.

role.title: View
role.description: developer: your prompt, task and session. manager: the sprint by task and the sessions working now.

projectFolder.title: Project folder
projectFolder.description: Count only sessions inside this folder (absolute path). Empty counts every session.

person.title: Your name
person.description: How you appear in the team's sprint view. Only used with a team server.

serverUrl.title: Team server
serverUrl.description: Only for projects without .pigment/config.json; that file normally holds the team server's address.

teamKey.title: Team key
teamKey.description: Optional: Pigment also finds the key the server setup saved on this computer, or the one you paste in its pane.

jiraSite.title: Jira site
jiraSite.description: Your Jira site, e.g. yourteam.atlassian.net. Manager: for the sprint list. Developer: to log worked time when a task reaches Testing. Can also live in .pigment/config.json.

jiraEmail.title: Jira email
jiraEmail.description: The email you sign in to Jira with.

jiraToken.title: Jira API token
jiraToken.description: A Jira API token: reads the sprint, and logs worked time only when you press Log it in Jira.

logOnStatus.title: Log time at status
logOnStatus.description: When your task reaches this Jira status, I offer to log your worked time on it. Done always counts too.
